_comment: Homelab Bridge with a docker and a proxmox source, against the fake upstreams (docs/REFERENCE_SERVER.md#docker, #proxmox). Start: python3 server/fake_upstream.py server/recordings/docker/normal.json --port 8796 & python3 server/fake_upstream.py server/recordings/proxmox/normal.json --port 8797 & then HOMELAB_TOKENS=<16+ characters> PVE_TOKEN=any-made-up-secret python3 server/reference_server.py --config server/examples/sources-docker-proxmox.json. For real use: the docker url is your socket proxy (http://socket-proxy:2375), the proxmox url https://<node>:8006 with ca_file.
name: bridge docker and proxmox

sources.name: Docker
sources._actions: Opt-in. Without the actions key the source is read-only and the socket proxy needs no POST.

sources.name: Proxmox
sources._actions: Opt-in. Needs VM.PowerMgmt on /vms/<vmid> for exactly these guests; stop is a clean shutdown.
